description.value: This study examined cortical thickness, surface area, and gyrification index in relation to cannabis use, dependence, and cannabis onset age using a large multisite MRI sample.

spans.text: Here, we comprehensively examined cortical thickness, surface area, and gyrification index in relation to cannabis use, dependence, and onset age, across the whole cortex

description.value: Cross-sectional multisite observational study using aggregated data from four independent research sites.
